mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 4.5% signal economic weakness, prompting equity investors to anticipate lower corporate earnings and demand negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates and high unemployment rates indicate a monetary policy response to economic distress, which typically precedes equity market rebounds as investors anticipate stimulus; this combination predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 1.0 and UNRATE > 4.0), or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts above 1600 thousand units signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with HOUST > 1600, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent monthly inflation above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals central bank hawkishness and potential rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output and economic activity, which typically precedes positive equity market performance over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with rising INDPRO (monthly change > 0.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth above 150,000 jobs signals a tight labor market and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales above 485,000 million dollars indicate strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenues and predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with RSAFS > 485000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
